local self=require('openmw.self')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local frames=0
local strike=0
local wasUse=false
local released=nil
local done=false
local selected=nil
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frames=frames+1
 assert(Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current>0,'Player died in western rat fight')
 if frames==5 then print('Western rat fight ready') end
 local target=nil
 local distance=math.huge
 local dead=0
 for _,id in ipairs({{0x3b513}}) do
  local rat=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
  assert(rat and rat:isValid(),'Western rat missing')
  if Actor.isDead(rat) then dead=dead+1
  else
   local d=(rat.position-self.position):length()
   if d<distance then target=rat distance=d end
  end
 end
 if distance<170 then print('Western rat close approach') end
 if selected and selected:isValid() and not Actor.isDead(selected) then
  target=selected distance=(target.position-self.position):length()
 else selected=target end
 local x=0
 if target then
  local d=target.position-self.position
  local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0))
  local angle=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
  x=math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(angle*5120+.5)))
 end
 print(string.format('Western rat aim x=%d y=0 distance=%.2f',x,distance))
 if not done and dead==1 then done=true print('Western rats defeated') end
 local use=self.controls.use~=0
 if use and not wasUse then strike=strike+1 released=nil print('Western strike '..strike..' armed') end
 if wasUse and not use then released=core.getSimulationTime() end
 if released and core.getSimulationTime()-released>=1 then print('Western strike '..strike..' settled') end
 wasUse=use
 timer=timer+dt
 if timer>=1 then print('Trap player position '..tostring(self.position)) end
 if timer>=1 then timer=0 print('Western rat fight health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' remaining='..(1-dead)) end
end}}}}
